tutorial.say: The numbers next to a row, or above a column, count the bombs in that whole line. This 3 means the third row holds exactly 3 bombs.
A 0 is a gift: no bomb anywhere in that line. The second and the last row both say 0, so all their cells are safe.
Columns work the same way: the numbers on top count the bombs of each column. Here every column holds exactly 1 bomb.
Counts become powerful when you combine them with each other and with the numbers inside the grid.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Use the counts and the numbers to find all the bombs.
